map.峰值日照时数和实际日照时间一样吗？: Are peak sunshine hours the same as actual sunshine time?
map.不一样。峰值日照时数是把全天辐照折算成标准 1 kW/m² 下的等效小时数，通常: No. Peak sunshine hours convert the whole day's irradiation into equivalent hours at the standard 1 kW/m², usually far less than the daylight duration, and are the core input for PV capacity estimation.
map.倾角如何选？: How to choose the tilt angle?
map.近似取当地纬度可获得全年较优；若以冬季用电为主可适当增大倾角提升低温期辐照，需结: Approximately using the local latitude gives a good year-round result; if winter usage dominates, increasing the tilt slightly can raise cold-season irradiation, but consider shading and snow load.
